title: Product Engineer
description:
**About Us**
 Velory empowers companies to automate and secure IT asset management in one seamless platform. From purchase to end-of-life, our software ensures complete control over IT assets with a sustainable, circular approach.
   

  

 Velory is transforming how companies buy, manage, and reuse IT. Our platform automates the entire IT lifecycle from procurement to end-of-life helping companies operate smarter and save both time and money.
   

  

 We’ve already proven that this model works. Now, we’re scaling it across Europe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 You’ll join our Data & Operations team, working closely with Sales, Product and Finance to turn data into actionable insights, streamline processes and drive operational efficiency through automation and AI.
   

  

**You will**
* Build and automate reporting to improve visibility into business performance.
* Analyse business processes and customer interactions to identify trends, insights and opportunities for improvement.
* Develop models based on customer behaviour to support data-driven decision-making.
* Champion AI-driven efficiencies by helping teams leverage LLMs, coding agents and automation tools effectively.
* Drive integrations, implement app improvements and support cross-functional enhancement projects.

* Proficiency in SQL, including writing queries, and Excel, including formulas and pivot tables.
* Experience with TypeScript.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, modern coding agents and related tooling.
* Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams.
* A proactive, self-driven mindset and eagerness to learn, experiment and continuously improve.


****Who You Are****
 To excel in this role, you should embody Velory's core values and bring a creative, innovative spirit to our team:
   

  

* Show ownership: Look at the big picture and take the initiative to contribute where needed.
* Manage speed: Eliminate obstacles to maintain a high, sustainable pace.
* Represent quality: Aim high, sweat the details, and iterate.
* Earn trust: Be communicative, transparent, and follow through on commitments.
* Deliver wow: Go beyond expectations in a creative and unexpected way.


****What We Offer****
* A unique opportunity to grow and learn in a fast-paced scale-up environment.
* A collaborative and inclusive work culture.
* Flexible work arrangements.
* Daily breakfast buffet at the office.
* Workouts with PT at the office gym.
* Private healthcare insurance and a generous wellness grant.
* Six weeks of paid vacation and ITP1-level pension.
* Select your preferred equipment via our own Velory Platform.
* Stockholm HQ with remote flexibility


****Join Us****
 At Velory, you’ll be more than just an employee you're a key player in our mission to revolutionize the digital landscape. If you’re ready to bring your creativity, skills and passion to our team, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Customer Success Manger
description:
At Ingrid, we help retailers turn delivery into a competitive advantage. Our platform connects merchants, carriers, and consumers to create smarter delivery experiences — improving conversion, reducing friction, and building stronger customer loyalty. We work with some of the most well-known retail brands in Europe, and we’re on a mission to create a better delivery experience for everyone.
   

  

 We’re now looking for a Customer Success Manager to join our team.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Customer Success Manager at Ingrid, you will independently manage a portfolio of approximately 40–70 customers. You will drive adoption, customer value, retention, and growth by connecting customer goals with Ingrid’s products and capabilities. You will own the customer relationship and success planning, while also taking responsibility for renewals and selected upsell opportunities within an agreed commercial scope.
   

  

 This role is well suited to someone who is ready to take full ownership of a customer portfolio, enjoys combining relationship management with data and commercial thinking, and wants to contribute to how Customer Success continues to evolve at Ingrid.
   

  

 This role is based in Stockholm and will require being in the office at least two days a week.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Own and develop relationships across a portfolio of Core and Growth customers
* Define and execute success plans aligned with customer goals
* Lead customer meetings, training sessions, and business reviews
* Use data and insights to identify risks, trends, and optimization opportunities
* Drive product adoption and measurable customer value
* Own renewals and selected upsell opportunities within agreed commercial frameworks
* Partner with Sales on larger or more complex expansion opportunities
* Coordinate across Product, Support, Implementation, and Sales to deliver customer outcomes
* Contribute customer insights and help improve Customer Success processes and playbooks


**We think you will thrive in this role if you have**
* Experience in Customer Success or Account Management
* Experience independently managing a portfolio of customer accounts
* Experience in logistics, ecommerce, delivery, or retail tech
* A good understanding of SaaS, customer lifecycle, adoption, retention, and growth
* Commercial confidence and experience in owning renewal and upsell conversations
* Strong communication and facilitation skills
* A structured and data-driven approach to customer management
